Chapter 11: the 8-bit CPU ACC8 (6 levels)

The player builds a complete, programmable 8-bit processor: fetching
16-bit instructions from the wide program memory, the control unit as
a microprogram in two ROMs (CTRL8), the arithmetic path with load, the
jump logic (JUMP), the whole CPU without its program memory (CPU8,
checked step by step against the emulator with a test program that
uses every instruction) and the computer of CPU8 and PROM running that
program. Solution builder: touching pins count as joined.
